question: Add a 'pages' term to free_tier.unit and a 'page-count' (or 'pages') term to free_tier.metered_on in scripts/dossier/schema.json
why: OCR and document parsing offers are denominated in pages (Unstructured 10,000 pages once, Mistral OCR USD per 1,000 pages, Mathpix and Reducto per page, LlamaParse credits per page); the records use 'mixed' or 'credits' for the unit and 'unstated' for metered_on and name pages in their text
